article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Bryan Ndjonga had 17 points in Canisius' 84-43 win over Allegheny on Thursday. Ndjonga added seven rebounds for the Golden Griffins (1-1). Kahlil Singleton scored 16 points while going 6 of 12 (4 for 10 from 3-point range) and added six rebounds. Chris Kumu shot 7 of 11 from the field and 2 for 3 from the line to finish with 16 points. James Sitter led the way for the Gators with 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
